notes.title: Sneak Peak of the Farming and Shop Systems
notes.content:
Development has really started to take off now with a team of developers and designers, we are very fortunate to have such a talented team.

Here is some preview/sneak peak shots of the Farming and Shop systems. We think they look fantastic, let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38783339/9bc4c54c88607cf3fc4054fdf14cf6fa9d489a68.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38783339/2a6e9a57af07a3ac301ce9c93bcdc35f63b69cd5.png[/img]

Thanks for keeping up with the latest updates. If you are a fan, please share the news and be sure to support us on [url=http://kck.st/3zwfxxj]Kickstarter[/url] for additional features like Multiplayer, huge savings on release price and so much more!

Thanks,
Team Hemp Co.

notes.title: Kickstarter Launch Event
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We wanted to post an update to share that we just launched Hemp Co. on Kickstarter! We also updated the release date and enabled Steam Early Access. Are you ready?

Within the first hour we had 5 backers to our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hempcogame/hemp-co-game/]Kickstarter[/url], thank you so much!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hempcogame/hemp-co-game/]Support Hemp Co. on Kickstarter[/url]

Ohhh la la, we have some new concept art as a posted update on Kickstarter to be sure to check it out ASAP!

Thanks & We hope to provide more updates here soon!

Hemp Co. Team
